Messages.Author: Brian Wilson
Messages.Body:
We had a little "discussion" last night about Peace Treaty. As you know,
Peace Treaty is a political action that burns all weapons in play if it
passes, unless a Methuselah wants to pay the equipping cost of the weapon
again to keep it.

What's the official word on weapons with no equipping cost? Some say that
since there is no cost, you can keep it for free. Others say that since
there is no equipping cost, it's impossible to pay it and so the weapon
gets burned.

--

Arrogantly twisting the sterile canvas snoot of a | a-Henh!
fully charged icing annointment utensil, he poots forth |
a tiny green rosette near the summit of a dense but | Brian
radiant muffin of his own design. | Wilson
|
We miss you, Frank! |

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
A weapon with no equip cost, or an equip cost of 0, will survive a Peace
Treaty without any pool having to be paid.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.

Except you can save the weapons during a peace treaty by repaying
their cost...which for the Zip and the Grenade is, in fact, zero.
